meta.name: Reference Chain Mechanic
meta.collision_rule: A chain must not end on a spec row the REQUESTING sector has already been sent to by one of its own existing faults, or the team can answer from its notes instead of asking. Checked by tools/build_reference_chain_faults.js.
meta.note: THE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the twelve reference-chain faults. Hand-edited; the generator reads it. It holds NO resolution codes and NO three-digit values: every number is resolved from content/specs.json at build time by (binder, table, item). Change a spec value in the workbook, re-run the generator, and every code here follows it. If you find a number in this file that is not a crew count or a material count, it does not belong.
meta.third_value_rule: THREE VALUES (2026-10-06). A P-08 fault resolves on three values: its two chains give VALUE 1 and VALUE 2 in order, and `direct_values` gives VALUE 3 — a row named outright, not a chain: the requesting sector's own indexed table (OWN_TABLE), its own Appendix C (OWN_APPENDIX) or another sector's indexed table (EXTERNAL). Never another sector's Appendix C. The generator resolves the row from content/specs.json, checks the declared source_type against the row it finds, and refuses an undeclared `overlap`: where the requesting sector is already sent to that row by one of its own faults, the source must name that fault, so the repeat is a decision on record rather than an accident. P-07 is unchanged: one chain, one value.
meta.round_note: Deliberately unscheduled (2026-10-04). A fault with round:null is never dealt by activateRound, so these are facilitator-issue only until the mechanic has been playtested and each one is given a round.

reference_directory._note: What each sector's binder holds in subsection 5A. A row's DISPLAY is derived — '<target_item> [<target_sector>]' — never written here, so a renamed spec row renames every reference that points at it.

faults.name: Turbine coolant interlock mismatch
faults.flavour: The coolant interlock will not arm: the route class it expects is held outside this sector.

faults.name: Core auxiliary feed mismatch
faults.flavour: Two interlocks, two authorities, and a bus rating of your own. Only the last figure is written in this binder.

faults.name: Intake pump control desync
faults.flavour: The intake controller wants the environmental circuit rating. Agriculture logs which circuit that is.

faults.name: Reclaim sterilisation lock
faults.flavour: Sterilisation will not release without a biological clearance, a bypass rating and an override authorisation.

faults.name: Ward pressure isolation mismatch
faults.flavour: Ward isolation is reading a supply pressure the ward does not own.

faults.name: ICU failover routing conflict
faults.flavour: Failover needs a route rating, a telemetry rating and a reservoir pressure figure before it will hand over.
faults.design_note: The second chain loops back to MED. MED only learns which of its own bio-filter ratings matters after speaking to COM.

faults.name: Freight spur cooling signal mismatch
faults.flavour: The freight spur's cooling signal is calibrated to a turbine this sector cannot see.
faults.design_note: The canonical chain: TRN asks WTR, WTR holds Turbine D [POW], and TRN must then obtain the Turbine D value from POW.

faults.name: Emergency tunnel routing blackout
faults.flavour: The beacons, the diversion and the emergency bus each want a figure, and none is a transport figure.
faults.design_note: The second chain loops back to TRN. Only Agriculture logs which tunnel its seedling freight occupies.

faults.name: Nutrient loop sensor mismatch
faults.flavour: The nutrient loop is reading a flow rate nobody in this bay can confirm.

faults.name: Seed vault climate interlock
faults.flavour: The vault will not seal until its broadcast clearance, its chiller feed and its own humidity setpoint are confirmed.

faults.name: Relay cooling telemetry mismatch
faults.flavour: The relay mast is cooled off somebody else's loop, and it wants that loop's rating.

faults.name: Uplink emergency power-route conflict
faults.flavour: The uplink wants its feed rating, its cabinet filtration rating and its reset key. It holds only the last.
